nodes.name: On Workflow Error
nodes.notes: Global error trigger. Fires when any workflow that names this one as its Error Workflow throws an unhandled error. Set on 01, 02, 02b (and 00) in step 6.1.

nodes.name: Build Error Report
nodes.notes: Parses the Error Trigger payload into a run_logs 'failed' row + a #automation-errors Block Kit alert. lead_id is null: the error-trigger payload does not carry it reliably; the execution URL lets the operator drill into the failed run.

nodes.name: Log Failure To Supabase
nodes.notes: Persists the crash to run_logs (status=failed). Continue-On-Fail so a Supabase blip never stops the Slack alert.

nodes.name: Alert Errors Channel
nodes.notes: Immediate crash alert to #automation-errors via chat.postMessage (bot token). Same hardening as the M5 Slack node (4 tries / 3s / 15s) against intermittent egress resets.

parameters.content:
## 99 - Global Error Handler
Fires ONLY on an unhandled crash in 01 / 02 / 02b (each names this workflow as its Error Workflow). Writes a `run_logs` row (status=failed) and alerts #automation-errors.

NOT for graceful degradation: AI/Twilio/Slack outages are Continue-On-Fail in the main flows, logged `partial`, and surfaced by the 03 daily digest — they do not crash and so do not reach here.
